message: I was chatting with a friend the other day about emergency plans, and she confessed she tends to panic whenever there's a storm warning. I totally get it! It can feel overwhelming. But it reminded me how important it is to have our go-bags ready and a family plan in place. It doesn’t have to be scary; it’s just about feeling prepared and calm. Anyone else have a friend who panics, or a tip for staying grounded during uncertainty? 😊
